create_InMemoryCache: create an InMemoryCache instance with configurable max size, TTL, and per-item size limits
build_set_cache: build a cache entry with a key and value, optionally specifying a custom TTL
test_get_cache: test retrieving a cached value by key, returning None if expired or missing
refactor_evict_cache: refactor the eviction policy to remove expired items and enforce max cache size using a min-heap
review_increment_cache: review the increment_cache method that atomically reads, adds, and writes back an integer value
